result.instructions: Tools for NS1 Connect, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which DNS zones do I have, and how many records does my account use in total?"; "How many DNS queries did acme-example.com get in the last 30 days?"; "Find every DNS record with 'shop' in its name across my zones.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes NS1 Connect data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ns1_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ns1_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ns1_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. ns1_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ns1_list_zones
tools.title: List zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones in the account: name, id, TTL/SOA settings, primary/secondary setup, linked zones and tags. If next_page is not null, call again with its after/offset to get more. GET /v1/zones.

limit.description: Maximum items per page, 1-1000. Omit for NS1's default page size.

after.description: Continue after this item: pass next_page.after from the previous reply.

offset.description: Skip this many items: pass next_page.offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: ns1_get_zone
tools.title: Get zone
tools.description: One zone with its settings and its record list (each record: domain, type, TTL, short answers, linked/tier info). Large zones are paged: if next_page is not null, call again with its after/offset to get the next records. TSIG secrets are redacted. GET /v1/zones/{zone}.

limit.description: Maximum items per page, 1-1000. Omit for NS1's default page size.

after.description: Continue after this item: pass next_page.after from the previous reply.

offset.description: Skip this many items: pass next_page.offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: ns1_get_record
tools.title: Get record
tools.description: One DNS record by zone, domain and type: TTL, answers (with per-answer metadata), filter chain (traffic steering), linked record and region settings. GET /v1/zones/{zone}/{domain}/{type}.

domain.description: Full record name inside the zone, e.g. www.example.com (or the zone name itself for the apex).

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT.

tools.name: ns1_search
tools.title: Search zones and records
tools.description: Search the account's zones and records by name (substring match). Returns matching zones and/or records with their answers when expand is true. GET /v1/search.

query.description: Text to look for in zone and record names (at least 2 characters).

tools.name: ns1_list_monitoring_jobs
tools.title: List monitoring jobs
tools.description: List the account's NS1 monitoring jobs (health checks that feed traffic steering): id, name, type, regions, frequency, rules, current status, active flag and notify list id. Request header values and credentials are redacted. GET /v1/monitoring/jobs.

tools.name: ns1_get_monitoring_job
tools.title: Get monitoring job
tools.description: One monitoring job by id with its configuration, rules, regions and status. Header values and credentials are redacted. GET /v1/monitoring/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: ns1_list_notify_lists
tools.title: List notifier lists
tools.description: List the notifier lists that monitoring alerts are sent to: id, name and the notifier types and labels (email, Slack, PagerDuty, webhook). Notifier settings (webhook URLs, tokens, service keys, addresses) are redacted. GET /v1/lists.

tools.name: ns1_list_data_sources
tools.title: List data sources
tools.description: List the data sources (connections to third-party monitoring or custom push sources used for traffic steering): id, name, source type, status and their feeds. Connection settings and credentials are redacted. GET /v1/data/sources.

tools.name: ns1_get_data_source
tools.title: Get data source
tools.description: One data source by id with its feeds. Connection settings and credentials are redacted. GET /v1/data/sources/{id}.

tools.name: ns1_list_data_feeds
tools.title: List data feeds of a source
tools.description: List the feeds of one data source (each feed is one monitored item, e.g. one server's health) with id, name and settings. GET /v1/data/feeds/{source_id}.

tools.name: ns1_get_data_feed
tools.title: Get data feed
tools.description: One data feed of a source by id. GET /v1/data/feeds/{source_id}/{feed_id}.

tools.name: ns1_get_account_summary
tools.title: Get account summary
tools.description: The account's subscription, resources and utilization (queries, records, filter chains, monitors, ... against the plan limits). GET /v1/account/summary.

tools.name: ns1_get_usage_stats
tools.title: Get query usage statistics
tools.description: DNS query counts for the whole account, one zone, or one record (give zone, or zone + domain + type). period is 1h, 24h or 30d; aggregate, expand, limit and after apply to the account and zone levels only (a record takes just period). If next_page is not null, call again with its after/limit. GET /v1/stats/usage[/{zone}[/{domain}/{type}]].

domain.description: Full record name inside the zone, e.g. www.example.com (or the zone name itself for the apex).

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT.

period.description: Time window: 1h, 24h or 30d. Omit for the API default.

aggregate.description: Sum the counts over the period.

expand.description: Break the counts down further. Account and zone level only.

limit.description: Maximum items per page, 1-1000. Omit for NS1's default page size.

after.description: Continue after this item: pass next_page.after from the previous reply.

tools.name: ns1_get_qps_stats
tools.title: Get queries per second
tools.description: Current queries per second for the whole account, one zone, or one record (give zone, or zone + domain + type). GET /v1/stats/qps[/{zone}[/{domain}/{type}]].

domain.description: Full record name inside the zone, e.g. www.example.com (or the zone name itself for the apex).

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT.

tools.name: ns1_get_billing_records
tools.title: Get records usage (billing)
tools.description: How many DNS records the account uses against its plan limit in the current billing cycle. GET /billing-usage/v1/records.

tools.name: ns1_get_billing_queries
tools.title: Get query usage (billing)
tools.description: Billable DNS query usage between two Unix timestamps. GET /billing-usage/v1/queries?from=&to=.

tools.name: ns1_create_record
tools.title: Create DNS record
tools.description: WRITE: creates ONE new DNS record and CHANGES LIVE DNS for that name as soon as NS1 serves it; a wrong answer can take a site or mail offline. Plain records only (A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, CNAME, MX, PTR, SRV, TXT; no NS/SOA, no traffic-steering filters or metadata). Refuses when the record already exists (use ns1_update_record). Answers are lists of rdata fields: A ["192.0.2.10"], MX [10, "mail.example.com."], TXT ["v=spf1 -all"], SRV [10, 5, 5060, "sip.example.com."], CAA [0, "issue", "letsencrypt.org"]. PUT /v1/zones/{zone}/{domain}/{type}.

domain.description: Full record name inside the zone, e.g. www.example.com (or the zone name itself for the apex).

answers.description: One entry per answer, each a list of rdata fields (see the tool description).

ttl.description: TTL in seconds. Omit for the zone default.

tools.name: ns1_update_record
tools.title: Update DNS record
tools.description: WRITE: changes ONE existing DNS record and CHANGES LIVE DNS for that name immediately. Giving answers REPLACES all current answers of the record (send the complete new set); giving only ttl changes just the TTL. Plain records only (A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, CNAME, MX, PTR, SRV, TXT): when answers are given, a record that uses traffic-steering filters, links or per-answer metadata is refused (edit it in the NS1 portal). Fails if the record does not exist. POST /v1/zones/{zone}/{domain}/{type}.

domain.description: Full record name inside the zone, e.g. www.example.com (or the zone name itself for the apex).

type.description: Record type of the existing record.

answers.description: The COMPLETE new answer set, each answer a list of rdata fields (as for ns1_create_record).
